result.stdout:
ratchet - the two-level roadmap runner.

Usage:
  ratchet --roadmap <path> [--rollout <key>] [options]

Options:
  --manifest <path>               manifest file (default: Plans/rollouts.json)
  --rollout <key>                 rollout entry (default: the sole entry, if unambiguous)
  --roadmap <path>                roadmap file the run drives
  --repo-root <path>              repository root (default: .)
  --dry-run                       print the resolved plan and exit; no claude, no git
  --report                        build the metering report from the persisted store and exit; no claude, no git
  --bill                          build the per-client billing report under the manifest commercial model and exit; no claude, no git
  --reconcile                     reconcile the measured estimate against the Usage & Cost API billed figure and exit; no claude, no git
  --report-out <dir>              directory the report/billing/reconciliation artifacts are written to (default: .ratchet/)
  --from <phase>                  start at this roadmap phase, skipping earlier (already-closed) phases (alias: --start-phase)
  --single-phase                  stop after the first in-scope phase closes (don't chain on); review + merge, then re-run with --from <next> (default off)
  --skip-readiness-check          skip the plugin-enabled preflight (escape hatch for false negatives)
  --claude-path <path>            explicit claude launcher path (overrides PATH; also via RATCHET_CLAUDE)
  --quiet                         suppress per-step narration and lifecycle chatter (warnings/alerts still shown)
  --no-color                      disable ANSI colour/styling (also honoured via the NO_COLOR environment variable)
  --pr-review                     after each phase closes, open a PR, review it in a fresh session, and on a clean verdict auto-merge (opt-in; default off; also via manifest prReview)
  --max-pr-iterations <n>         PR review↔remediate cap (default: 3)
  --allow-dirty                   bypass the clean-tree preflight
  --
[truncated]
